customManagers.description: Worker Go flake: propose monthly nixpkgs-unstable channel digest updates to the manifest, embedded seed and guard together. PRs intentionally arrive red until a maintainer regenerates the matching lock key and Nix-evaluated Go version/output metadata; postUpgrade lock generation is not allowed here.
Pinned CI Postgres env reference: the step-managed database keeps its tag and digest grouped with docker-compose.yml.

Codex native runtime identity: keep the install version, manifest version, raw release tag and source commit together. Numeric consumers keep their existing lock keys. The two archive matches below are disjoint from this block.

Codex musl archives: separate per-arch tag/hash matches avoid overlapping replacements. Release attachments updates the SHA256 with the raw rust-v tag; the installer checks all tags agree. Distinct aliases prevent same-file deduplication.

uzi CI tool pins carrying a `# renovate: datasource=.. depName=..` annotation on the line directly above the version literal, for pins WITHOUT a companion sha256 (including Taskfile tool pins). config:recommended already tracks go.mod / package-lock / Dockerfile FROM / GHA uses:; this covers versions pinned inline in shell that no built-in manager sees, VERSION only. Pins that DO have a companion sha256 (go-task, sqlc, actionlint) use the `# renovate-tarball:` marker + the github-release-attachments manager below instead, so their sha bumps in lockstep -- do NOT give a sha-carrying pin the `datasource=` marker or both managers would match it.

uzi CI tool pins that curl a GitHub release tarball and `sha256sum -c` it (go-task in .github/actions/setup-task, sqlc + actionlint in ci.yml, per-platform golangci-lint archives in scripts/golangci-lint.sh). The github-release-attachments datasource makes Renovate bump the VERSION and companion sha256 together in one PR: it resolves the new asset's sha256 from the release checksum asset or by hashing it. The *_VERSION literal MUST be the v-prefixed git tag because getDigest fetches releases/tags/<value> verbatim; shell code may strip the leading v for versionless asset names. An optional packageName lets distinct depName aliases prevent Renovate's same-file deduplication while resolving one upstream package. Marked `# renovate-tarball:` so the version-only generic manager above does NOT also match these. Linter/codegen pins (sqlc drift, actionlint findings) still arrive red-with-work by design; go-task and golangci-lint arrive with complete hashes.

packageRules.description: Worker Go channel digests need matching lock metadata and image validation before merge; keep them independent of major/minor Go toolchain grouping.
prBodyNotes: This channel digest update requires maintainer lock repair: regenerate the Go package key, evaluate the pinned go_1_27 version and Linux store output with Nix, and update the lock metadata. The worker-toolchain repository guard and baked image version assertion deliberately keep this PR red until that work is complete.

packageRules.description: Patch updates automerge on green CI. Repo auto-merge is off, so Renovate merges them itself: it rebases a behind branch first (strict required checks), then merges once every check is green. Later rules override this one (Codex runtime, the agent SDK).

Agent runtime core: one reviewed Codex runtime upgrade PR, never automerged; every bump gets an adoption read of its release notes (uzi-lander references/renovate.md). Stable release timestamps share the repository's seven-day age and nightly schedule. Runtime probe/launcher parity deliberately blocks a lock-only bump until upgrade work is done.
prBodyNotes: This updates the native Codex runtime, not an npm SDK. It arrives red by design: land it from your own branch carrying this lock plus the output of `task codex-pins:sync` (every Codex version and digest pin rewritten from the lock), then check protocol compatibility. Adding a model to uzi's curated picker is separate work.

CI coverage: the required test-agent check runs the agent suite, the real-binary test:codex-m4 suite on amd64 and the worker-uid lane; the required codex-packaged-proof-gate covers the strict packaged OS/uid/Landlock proof for both templates on amd64 and the arm64 package check (SHA256, members, manifest, codex --version as the runner uid). The amd64 image builds run but are not required. Not covered by any PR check: an arm64 image build or packaged proof, executing the code-mode host on arm64, check:codex-m4-receipts, and live provider/subscription entitlement. Say which of these were run by hand before merging.

Adoption read: review every intermediate rust-v release note for breaking changes and capabilities worth adopting (uzi-lander references/renovate.md); propose follow-ups as separate enhancement issues.

packageRules.description: workers.image.repository is a PREFIX (controller appends /agent-<template>), not a resolvable image; and the worker tag is operator-advanced/decoupled from appVersion (PRD #422 Decision 1/3), so it must not be Renovate-tracked.
shellcheck is pinned in two managers (ci.yml tarball+sha via github-release-attachments; Taskfile lint:shell arg via github-releases). Group so a bump moves both in lockstep in one PR.
golangci-lint: group the Taskfile version and both platform archive hashes for every update. Distinct depName aliases avoid same-file deduplication; shared packageName joins them here.
sqlc: group the CI pin and all platform release archives so local generation stays in lockstep with CI.
govulncheck: group the api + controller Taskfile pins so a bump moves both in one PR. Distinct depName aliases avoid same-file deduplication; shared packageName joins them here.
Go toolchain: keep major and minor go/golang updates eligible for one branch without grouping their patch or digest refreshes.
Go toolchain: group major/minor go.mod/toolchain and setup-go updates with golang builder images. Patch and digest refreshes stay independent.
Go toolchain: a major/minor golangci-lint update must land with the Go surfaces so its build-Go supports the selected toolchain.

KinD toolchain: group helm/kind-action and kindest/node because the action downloads a default kind that must understand the node image's kubeadm API. KinD smoke remains the gate for one-sided releases.
Agent runtime core: every bump gets an adoption read of its release notes (uzi-lander references/renovate.md), so it is never automerged.

Postgres is pinned twice: docker-compose.yml (`postgres`) and ci.yml's test-api-store-it UZI_CI_PG_IMAGE env pin, which pulls through the mirror.gcr.io Docker Hub cache (`mirror.gcr.io/library/postgres`, #2621). Both must stay on the same tag and digest so the CI LiveDB lane tests the engine the stack ships, so they share one branch (#2622); scripts/check-postgres-pin-parity.sh gates the result.
